in_hebrew.name: יַדָדָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Jadda is derived from the Hebrew word yadadah, which means 'beloved'. This name is a feminine form and can be translated as 'my beloved' or 'beloved woman' in English.

in_greek.name: Ιάδα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Iada is a transliteration of the Hebrew name Jadda. It is also the name of a daughter of Jacob in the Old Testament.

in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Iada is a transliteration of the Greek name Iada, which is derived from the Hebrew name Jadda.
